hub.title: Production Transfer Process Center
hub.description: Manage material supply, WIP moves and output moves with production links, assignments, reservations, serial/lot tracking and traceability.

start.title: Start Transfer
start.description: Open the right supply or output task from a production order or a manual requirement.

execute.title: Execute Assignment
execute.description: Manage the task pool, assign work and advance material requests.

manage.title: Monitor and Manage
manage.description: Track records and manage availability, location and tolerance rules.

create.title: Create Production Transfer
create.description: Create material supply, inter-operation or output tasks from a production order or a manual requirement.

taskPool.title: Manager Task Pool
taskPool.description: Manage all production transfer tasks, remaining work and warehouse workload in one place.

materialRequests.title: KKD Material Request Orders
materialRequests.description: Scan a personnel card, load the linked account's open Netsis orders and prepare KKD distribution on the same page.

list.title: Transfer Records
list.description: Track planned, reserved, picked, dispatched and staged quantities.

settings.title: Process Settings
settings.description: Manage availability, shortage, assignment, location and tolerance rules.

multiShelf.title: Multi-shelf picking
multiShelf.description: Shelves containing stock {{stockCode}} are shown in one picking plan.
multiShelf.notice: On confirmation, every shelf is validated independently and successful rows are moved to the production staging shelf.
multiShelf.invalidQuantity: Enter a valid whole number for every shelf without exceeding its remaining quantity.
multiShelf.success: A total of {{quantity}} was picked from {{shelfCount}} shelves.
multiShelf.failed: Shelf picking could not be completed.
multiShelf.partialFailed: {{completed}} shelves were processed; the remaining shelves failed. {{detail}}

policy.title: Production Transfer Settings
policy.description: Centrally manage production order, material availability, assignment, location and tolerance rules.

source.netsisHint: Work orders and recipes are prepared live from Netsis read functions.
source.wmsHint: An approved planning system such as Windbox feeds the WMS source tables.
source.combined: List ERP and WMS orders together
source.combinedHint: Orders from both sources are shown with source labels; identical order numbers remain distinct.
source.boundaryText: External systems only feed versioned source work-order and recipe tables. WMS creates operational orders, transfers, reservations and stock movements within its own transaction boundary.

AfterHandover.title: Post automatically after handover
AfterHandover.description: When the requester confirms handover, WMS completes the stock movement first and then posts the same document to Netsis automatically.

Manual.title: Post manually by an authorized user
Manual.description: The transfer completes in WMS without creating a Netsis document. An authorized user posts it from the completed record.

Disabled.title: Do not post to Netsis
Disabled.description: The production transfer affects only WMS stock and location balances; no Netsis document is created.

fields.productionOrderSource: Where should production data be read from?
fields.wmsSourceSystemCodeHint: Must exactly match SourceSystemCode in RII_PR_SOURCE_ORDER.
fields.requireErpMasterDataForManualTransfer: Require ERP master-data validation for unplanned/manual transfers
fields.erpPostingPolicy: When should a completed production transfer be posted to Netsis?

erp.title: Netsis posting status
erp.postedWithCompletion: The production transfer completed and its Netsis document was created.
erp.failedAfterCompletion: The transfer completed in WMS, but Netsis posting failed. You can retry from the completed record.
erp.uncertainAfterCompletion: The transfer completed in WMS, but the Netsis result is uncertain. Check Netsis before retrying to avoid duplicates.
erp.retryFailed: Netsis posting could not be completed.

taskChain.handoffFromPrevious: Handed off from remaining work on task {{previous}}
taskChain.handoffToChild: Remaining quantity handed off to task {{child}}
taskChain.sameTaskReassign: Not processed yet; handoff reassigns users on the same task
